The '''Red Fury Brotherhood''' was one of many [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] groups operating out of the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. They were one of the two most powerful of such groups, along with the [[Order of Independent Trade]]. Near-constant infighting and assassinations prevented either group from growing, absorbing other groups, or carrying out any plans against rival crimelord [[Nirama]].<ref name="LFC">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

The pirates included representatives of many species, the most conspicuous of which was the organization's chief gunner, who had two heads. Other members included a cloaked reptilian, a pair of fanged blue bipeds, a squat purple being, a yellow being with one horn, and a gray alien with eyestalks.<ref name="D3" />

During a brief armistice to negotiate a possible amiable agreement among the pirate group leaders in the Cularin system, both this group and the [[Order of Independent Trade]] made a deal with Nirama to continue with their smuggling, while the other pirates were busy in the talks. Nirama found their scheming amusing, but nevertheless he kept at least one of his four eyes on the pirate activity of the system.<ref name="LFC" />

The Brotherhood pirates wore non-personalized [[Brotherhood badge|badges]] for identification.<ref name="itsc">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds}}</ref>

In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the Brotherhood signed a deal with [[Karae Nalvas]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|dark Jedi]] who was building a base called ''[[Conkesta]]'' in the low orbit of [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Genarius]]. The Brotherhood agreed to provide Nalvas's base with supplies over the course of several freighter trips. Nalvas's enemy [[Alec (Jedi)|Alec]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], discovered that most of the pirates in the Brotherhood enjoyed the annual four-day [[Festival]] of [[Tolea Biqua]], leaving their main base in asteroid [[L-7]] almost unprotected. Alec sent a party to steal a shuttle from L-7 during this festival, and to use the shuttle to pose as the Brotherhood in order to gain access to the ''Conkesta.'' This operation was successful.<ref name="itsc" />

When [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco]] traveled to the [[Almas Academy]], he hired the Brotherhood to patrol above [[Almas]], to prevent outsiders from coming there. However, they failed to stop an [[Alderaanian Resistance]] team that was sent by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Denia]].<ref name="Echoes of the Jedi">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they attempted to destroy an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] near [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]]. During this time, the Brotherhood also owned and operated [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Thaereian system]].
